description:
Kurta fabric with a Banarasi woven neck panel, scattered mirror work and a Banarasi woven border at the hem. Dupatta has Banarasi woven butis, a wide woven border and paisley motifs, finished with tassels.
Package includes: kurta fabric, salwar, dupatta

work.placement: Banarasi woven neck panel, hem border and dupatta butis and border
